en.name: Light Leak Transition
en.title: Light Leak Transition: Example and Code Recipe
en.description: A warm film light leak drifts across, peaks near white on the cut and carries one screen into the next. Make it with Claude Code or Codex.
howto: Build the leak from seven large radial gradients with different sizes, colors and paths, layered above the scene with mix-blend-mode screen: orange 1800x1300px, amber 1300x1000px, magenta 1000x1500px, a near-white core, a narrow streak with 24px blur, and two edge glows. Each one moves from off-screen with its own ease (power3.out, power2.out, power1.out, power1.inOut) from about 1s before the cut to about 1.5s after it, so the shape stays organic.

Put the scene swap on the brightest frame. A near-white flash layer rises to opacity 0.98 over 0.46s (power3.in) and holds for 0.08s around the cut, while the outgoing scene lifts to brightness(2.3) contrast(0.82) saturate(1.3). The cuts are at 2.8s, 5.7s and 8.3s; the incoming scene eases back to normal over 0.9s (power2.out) and its elements develop out of the overexposure. Raise film grain from 0.5 to 0.85 during the leak.

Press the copy button to send this recipe to Claude Code or Codex, or install the skill once with npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard. The agent builds the phone, the gallery, the picker and the leak for your own screens. Render an MP4 with HyperFrames, or port the GSAP timeline to your website.
faq: What is a light leak transition?

A light leak transition imitates the glow that stray light prints on film. A warm glow drifts across the frame, brightens until the picture is nearly white, and the next shot appears as the glow recedes. The cut is hidden inside the brightest frame.
How do you make a light leak in HTML and CSS?

Stack several large radial gradients in orange, amber and magenta over the scene with mix-blend-mode screen, move each on its own path and ease, and add a near-white flash layer that peaks on the cut frame. Lift the scene's brightness at the same moment and add film grain with overlay blending.

zh.name: 漏光转场
zh.title: 漏光转场：示例与代码配方
zh.description: 一团暖色胶片漏光从一侧飘过，在切点亮到近乎纯白，把一个界面接到下一个界面。用 Claude Code 或 Codex 按免费配方做出这个漏光转场。
howto: 用七团大的径向渐变拼出漏光，大小、颜色和路径各不相同，叠在场景上方，混合模式 screen：橙色 1800x1300px、琥珀 1300x1000px、洋红 1000x1500px、近白核心、模糊 24px 的窄光条，以及两团贴边的光。每团从画面外进来，各用自己的缓动（power3.out、power2.out、power1.out、power1.inOut），从切点前约 1s 持续到切点后约 1.5s，形状才显得有机。

把换场景放在最亮的一帧。一层近白闪光层用 0.46s（power3.in）升到不透明度 0.98，并在切点前后保持 0.08s，同时前一个场景的滤镜升到 brightness(2.3) contrast(0.82) saturate(1.3)。三个切点在 2.8s、5.7s、8.3s；下一个场景用 0.9s（power2.out）回到正常，里面的元素从过曝里显影出来。漏光期间把胶片颗粒的不透明度从 0.5 升到 0.85。
点击复制按钮，把配方发给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以用 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装 skill。agent 会按你自己的界面做出手机、相册、预设选择器和漏光。可以用 HyperFrames 渲染成 MP4，也可以把 GSAP 时间线移植到网站上。
faq: 漏光转场模仿杂散光在胶片上留下的光晕。一团暖色的光从画面一侧飘过，把画面照到近乎纯白，光退去时下一个镜头已经出现。切点藏在最亮的那一帧里。
怎么用 HTML 和 CSS 做漏光？
在场景上方叠几团橙色、琥珀、洋红的大径向渐变，混合模式用 screen，每团走自己的路径和缓动，再加一层在切点那一帧达到峰值的近白闪光层。同一时刻抬高场景的亮度，并用 overlay 混合叠上胶片颗粒。
